## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves

What problem does this feature address? Why is it needed?

How should this work? Describe the expected behavior, API, or interface.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why did this one win?

## 📦 Affected Interface

Which parts of the project does this affect? (check all that apply)

- [ ] MCP Server (`mcp-server/`)
- [ ] Documentation

## 📋 Additional Context

Any mockups, examples from other tools, reference links, or other details?
